method.detrend: gap-aware sliding running median, window 1.0 d, 3 iterations sigma-clip (+3/-6 sigma), segments split at gaps>0.5 d
method.bls: astropy BoxLeastSquares, likelihood objective, own log-uniform frequency grid with phase drift < dur_min/2 over baseline
method.depth_err: std of box means at random phases of the same duration (red-noise aware), out-of-transit excludes +-2 durations

sap_vs_psf.note: both on unmasked 1-d running-median detrend, full data, same P/t0/dur

psf_edge_trimmed.label: PSF, 0.25 d trimmed at every segment edge, then 1-d median detrend
